plan.notes: Source: official UIUC 2026-2027 Course Catalog page 'Computer Science, BS' (for the degree of Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Grainger College of Engineering, Siebel School of Computing and Data Science), transcribed by hand from the catalog's 'Sample Sequence' tables on 2026-09-30 from https://catalog.illinois.edu/undergraduate/engineering/computer-science-bs/. 128 credit hours across 8 semesters (Fall Year 1 through Spring Year 4), matching the catalog's stated minimum of 128 hours for graduation. All course codes, titles, and credit hours are verbatim from the official sample sequence. The catalog explicitly states the sample sequence is only a guide: students must work with their academic advisor on actual course selection and sequencing, and course availability is not guaranteed in the indicated semester. 'or' slots (MATH 221/MATH 220, Composition I/Gen Ed, CS 210/CS 211, MATH 257/MATH 415/MATH 416) reflect official catalog alternatives; choice_note records the details. Science Elective, CS Technical Elective (18 hours), CS Advanced Elective (6 hours), and Free Elective slots are student-choice courses per the official degree requirements; free electives are additional coursework, subject to Grainger College of Engineering restrictions, to reach at least 128 hours. Language Other Than English: students must fulfill the requirement by successfully completing a third level of a language other than English. CS 100 is listed as optional but highly recommended. The catalog does not publish per-slot prerequisites in the sample sequence, so prereq arrays are intentionally left empty — consult the official catalog course pages and an academic advisor.
